info.name: Rover DR REST API - Complete Test Collection
info.description: Complete REST API test collection for Rover DR. Covers sensors, motors, controller, rover state, request validation, contract verification, regression scenarios, lifecycle operations, monitor diagnostics, and REST API hardening. Includes validation tests for sensor operations and mode changes, motor stop and run-timed commands, controller state retrieval, consolidated rover state queries, CommandResult empty-payload handling, invalid Content-Length processing, HTTP 202 asynchronous restart and shutdown responses, CORS preflight (OPTIONS) requests, unknown-route handling, trailing-slash routing behavior, empty-body stop requests, system token validation, monitor failure diagnostics, and critical monitor failure policy exposure. Monitor diagnostics validation verifies the fields failed, critical, failure_type, and failure_message exposed by /api/state. Base URL is configured through the {{baseUrl}} collection variable (default: http://192.168.1.12:8080). Folder 99 must always be executed last because restart and shutdown operations are disruptive.
